$comment: Central site settings. Empty strings mean 'not supplied yet': the related UI stays hidden. Run `npm run build` after editing. Never put secret keys here; this file is published.

whatsapp.$comment: International format, digits only, no + or spaces (e.g. 34600000000). Leave empty to hide every WhatsApp button.

enquiry.$comment: provider: none | formspree | webhook | netlify. 'none' keeps the form in demo mode: it validates and reviews but tells the visitor nothing was sent.

payments.$comment: Online payment is prepared but OFF. The checkout endpoint must be a server function holding the provider's secret key (see server/README.md).

season.$comment: From the questionnaire: monthly hour timetable from March to September.
